selected_authority.authority_rule: Only the HR4C manifest-selected three-field slot is canonical PRE or POST state.

authority_components.commit: atomic manifest replacement selects staged three-field slot
authority_components.restart: open_existing validates manifest and discards incomplete staging

authority_components.commit: binds phase, pulse index, counters and generation to HR4C authority
requires each interval one PRE read and one POST write before finalize

non_authoritative_components.rule: May stage per-screen NEXT results and barrier receipts but may not promote state or own a pulse counter.
Existing S3/S4R/S5 qualification authority is not reused as formal E5 authority.

pre0.z_identity: full frozen longitudinal schedule; formal binding remains required

vx.rule: float64 zeros in each HR4C initialization batch

vy.rule: float64 zeros in each HR4C initialization batch

post_contract.mapping: POST.delta_n = PRE.delta_n + delta_n_increment; POST.vx = PRE.vx; POST.vy = PRE.vy
post_contract.commit: HR4DPulseTransaction.finalize commits only after every interval was read and written once

interpulse_contract.worker_semantics: distinct interval work only; adapter outputs remain non-authoritative staging

next_pre_contract.precondition: POST HR4C generation committed; all adapter NEXT records validated by barrier
next_pre_contract.commit: coordinator writes HR4C staging then atomically commits one PRE_(p+1) generation
next_pre_contract.counter_transition: generation and pulse_index advance exactly once together
next_pre_contract.final_pulse: POST_final is terminal; no next PRE transition

cross_pulse_invariants: one pulse index and one generation lineage
fresh E_source.copy for every optical pulse
previous optical output is never the next optical input
every interval reads PRE and writes POST exactly once
POST is canonical before hydro and PRE_next is canonical only after HR4C atomic commit
restart_points: after promotion before next optical pulse

e5_1_candidate.pulse_count_reason: two independent cross-pulse rollovers plus POST_final
e5_1_candidate.domain: complete frozen longitudinal schedule with full slow-state coverage
e5_1_candidate.old_48_screen_manifest_role: qualification evidence only; not the E5-1 state domain

reference_path.candidate: same authority plus non-authoritative streaming adapter

resource_model.conditional_hydro_transaction: 2G + G adapter NEXT staging = 3G = 106.267 GiB illustrative raw payload
resource_model.campaign_peak_conclusion: NOT_A_BOUND; depends on retention, checkpoints, diagnostics, optical memory and worker-local buffers
resource_model.s3_initializer_excluded: full-volume selected plus shared zero arrays would be 23.615 GiB host payload and is not selected for formal E5
